chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Shādhān ibn Nuʿaym, from a female servant of Ibrāhīm ibn ʿAbdah al-Naysābūrī, that she said:
I was standing with Ibrāhīm at al-Ṣafā, then he, peace be upon him, came until he stood by Ibrāhīm, took hold of the book of his rites, and spoke to him about some matters.

key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Ṣafā, the well-known sacred place in the hajj rites
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific for the Imam
key_terms.مَنَاسِكِهِ: his ritual rites, especially the rites of hajj

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith describe about the Imam’s meeting with Ibrāhīm at al-Ṣafā?
ai.summary: This report narrates an encounter at al-Ṣafā in which the Imam, peace be upon him, approached Ibrāhīm and examined his book of manāsik. It serves as a historical account of a direct meeting and reflects the Imam’s connection to matters of ritual practice and transmitted knowledge.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Shazan Bin Nuaym, from Khadim Al Ibrahim Bin Abda Al Neyshapouri that she said,
‘I was staying with Ibrahim at Al-Safa, so he<sup>asws</sup> came until he<sup>asws</sup> paused by Ibrahim and grabbed the book of his rituals and discussed some things with him’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn Shadhan ibn Nu‘aym from Ibrahim ibn ‘Abdahu al-Naysaburi’s house maid who has said the following.
“I was standing with Ibrahim on al-Safa’ that he (the twelfth Imam) came and stood higher than Ibrahim, took his Hajj guide book and spoke to him about a number of things.”
